messages:
sam: FYI we have a new customer (acrolabs) onboarded via OIDC. Console shows an API key but they get 403 when calling the hosted endpoint. Can someone take a look?

lina: Can you paste the project/tenant and an example request + error?

sam: project: prod-ACRO-001
tenant: acrolabs-prod
api_key_id: sk-REDACTED-123
example: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED-123\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -d \"{\\\"prompt\\\":\\\"hi\\\"}\"`
response: `{"error":"permission_denied","message":"API key missing project invoke scope"}`

lina: thanks. Provisioner bot logs? @provisioner-bot any events for sk-REDACTED-123?

provisioner-bot: created api_key id=sk-REDACTED-123 tenant=acrolabs-prod project=prod-ACRO-001 status=created binding_status=queued ts=2391056792

sam: interesting, binding_status=queued. customer says they waited ~20m and still 403.

raj: throwing this to infra — sometimes the IAM-sync worker falls behind. I see a backlog spike around 2391056800 in the iam-sync queue. Will check worker logs.

maya: quick heads-up — there was a regression in console v2.3.1 where newly created keys via OIDC path are granted `project:read` instead of `project:invoke` if the service role binding race happens. Could be related.

raj: confirmed. Worker crashed (OOM) at 2391056810, then leader election happened and a few bindings stayed in `queued`. I restarted the worker and requeued pending jobs.

ops-luis: To unblock immediate customer: you can manually rebind a key via admin API — internal endpoint: 
```
POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/admin/rebind
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
{
  \"api_key_id\": \"sk-REDACTED-123\",
  \"project\": \"prod-ACRO-001\",
  \"scopes\": [\"project:invoke\"]
}
```
(I ran this for a test key earlier)

lina: sam — can you try a rebind and then ask customer to retry? If you don't have admin token I can run it.

sam: I don't have admin token, please run it, thanks.

ops-luis: done. rebind request accepted, job id=j-839201, status=applied ts=2391056890 :white_check_mark:

provisioner-bot: updated api_key id=sk-REDACTED-123 binding_status=bound scopes=[project:invoke] ts=2391056895

sam: customer retried and reports success now — calls returning 200. They sent: `generation_id: gen_01c9`

maya: I'll open a small patch to ensure new keys get correct default scopes even when the iam-sync queue is momentarily delayed. Possible fix: set scopes at creation time atomically, not in a follow-up job.

raj: also adding alert for iam-sync worker OOM backlog to reduce time-to-detection.

sam: thanks everyone. Please keep me posted on the patch/alert. I'll update the customer that this was a transient infra race and we've re-applied permissions.

lina: noted. follow-up items:
- maya: patch console key creation (PR in progress)
- raj: add iam-sync backlog alert + investigate memory pattern
- ops-luis: can you add a small runbook for manual rebinds for tier-1 support?

ops-luis: will add runbook under internal runbooks -> \"manual-api-key-rebind\" by EOD.

sam: closing once runbook exists and PR is merged. Thanks :thumbsup:

maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/console/pulls/1423 — includes unit + integration test for atomic scope set.

ops-luis: runbook created and linked in support playbooks.

sam: all set from support side, customer confirmed stable for 1h. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
